h: Returning Through Torah and Prayer After Tishah B’Av

p: "The burnt offering of each Shabbos on its Shabbos."
and the holiness of each Shabbos
is alluded to in the parsha
that is read on that Shabbos.
for at the conclusion of the lamentations it says (Eichah 5:21):
"Bring us back, Hashem, to You, and we shall return;
renew our days as of old";
and in the Midrash Rabbah (end of Eichah):
all the corruption of Adam HaRishon,
so that it will be as before the sin;
as it says, 'These are the words,' etc.;
they said to Him: We do not know;
Weep and pray before Me," etc.
For the main breaking of the yetzer hara
and this is the meaning of
for it is the place of the novel development of halachos,
for "whoever is greater than his fellow,
and it renews itself each time
as it says in the Gemara (there; Sukkah 52a):
And even among the Tanna'im we find
regarding Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Meir:
"Were it not proclaimed about you in Heaven,
'Be careful with Rabbi Akiva and his Torah'";
"Be careful with Rabbi Meir and his Torah," etc.;
who were the root of Torah she'b'al peh.
And for this prayer is needed,
"Were it not that the Holy One, blessed is He,
And this is why there follows
in which the second Dibros are written,
of which it says (Shemos Rabbah 46 and 47)
and for rectifying all the past
And the beginning of the parsha,
which is the root of prayer;
...a nation that has God so near to it,
And Shabbos is the time of Torah,
that the Torah was given on Shabbos";
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
And it is the time for teshuvah,
"It is good to give thanks — lehodos — to Hashem";
for whoever confesses and forsakes his sin
is saved from the judgment of Gehinnom,
is given the requests of his heart";
and it is the time to merit teshuvah
whose holiness, alluded to in the parsha,
"The voice is the voice of Yaakov":
the kol of the heh, hakol, is the voice of prayer;
the kol with the vav is the voice of Torah;
for the letter vav is called the letter of truth,
And the time on this Shabbos
so that they will be redeemed immediately.
